blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — He was too nervous to eat. Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura admitted this on Monday before taking the witness stand in the Senate impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. READ: Impeachment court allows AMLC exec to testify despite defense objection Before proceedings resumed after lunch, Presiding Officer Sen. Francis Escudero asked Buenaventura if he had skipped his meal. “Hindi po makakain,” Buenaventura said. (I couldn’t eat) “Kinakabahan po, Your Honor,” he added, drawing laughter from some people in the session hall. (I was nervous) Buenaventura was called by the prosecution to testify on Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth. […]... Keep on reading: Nervous AMLC chief admits he skipped lunch before testimony
